origin_note: Coordinate reference on tabletop; hand-base commands operate ABOVE it. This is not a command to press the palm into the tabletop.

collision_checks.baseline_policy: Existing Dex5/wrist assembly overlaps may not deepen by more than 1 mm; other collisions require 2 mm clearance
collision_checks.limitations: Discrete convex-geom distances; adjacent/welded links excluded. Cup convex hull included conservatively despite visual-only contacts. Not exact CAD clearance or dynamics.

selected_path_check.note: Stale after net +7 cm environment height shift; trajectory must be revalidated.

reuse_policy: Fixed transform for future v3 recordings; do not re-fit or recenter each new demonstration. Revalidate every new path.
yaw_selection_note: Operator-confirmed horizontal alignment; replaces reachability-selected -60 degrees.
placement_note: Best tested front placement; retained 5 mm shift toward fixed G1. Broader finite search and dense comparisons did not improve sampled volume. Not globally optimal or full 50 cm coverage.
